description: Web-based database visualizer interface with HTML structure, CSS styles, and embedded JavaScript for loading and interacting with database and table data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases and resets selections.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Shows or hides tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders data into an HTML table structure.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates HTML for individual cell based on value type.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for full view.

search-terms: API endpoints for database, tables, data
